args.title: Ironbark Tooling Newsletter Summary — Warehouse Automation in 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter (Ironbark Tooling, "Warehouse automation in 2026"): announces the week's article on warehouse automation and offers a related webinar with a seat-hold registration link.
- Article (blog.ironbark.example/2026/warehouse): autonomous carts lifted pick rates by 18%, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece (insights.ironbark.example/warehouse/companion): the biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks.
